              items:

              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters
                of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the
                owners already in that city) assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SPR-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the
                last two digits of the registrationDate year (e.g. 'SPR-SMI-0007-M26').
              type: string
              example: 'SPR-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners who intentionally share a household
                (same last name and address, created with sharesHousehold=true). Present
                only for owners that belong to a shared household.
              type: string
              example: 'H-9F86D081884C'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier: 'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0 and an
                email is present, otherwise 'BRONZE'.
              type: string
              example: 'SILVER'
              readOnly: true

                The canonical region derived from the owner's city using the fixed

The spec: *when more than 80 owners have already been created today, the response includes `bulkSignupWarning: true`, otherwise `false`.*

I followed the codebase's existing pattern for derived owner fields (like `namesakeCount`, `customerCode`): compute at create time, persist on the entity, and expose it through the generated DTO so it's returned by both `POST /api/owners` and `GET /api/owners/{id}`.

Changes:

1. **New pipeline step** — `FlagBulkSignup.java`. Counts existing owners whose `registrationDate` equals the request's resolved business-day date (the same bucket `CheckDailyOwnerLimit` uses) and sets `bulkSignupWarning = count > 80` on the built owner. It runs before `SaveOwner`, so the new owner isn't self-counted — matching the "already been created" wording.

2. **Wiring** — inserted a `bulkSignup` step into `owners.POST.yml` between `namesakes` and `save`, under `govern: [ transaction ]`.

3. **Entity** — added the `bulkSignupWarning` (`Boolean`, column `bulk_signup_warning`) field with getter/setter to `Owner`.

4. **Schema** — added `bulk_signup_warning BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE` to all four DB schemas (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres). The `DEFAULT FALSE` keeps pre-existing/seed rows non-null so GET always yields `false` when unset.

5. **API contract** — added the `bulkSignupWarning` boolean (readOnly) property to the `Owner` schema in `openapi.yml`; the generated `OwnerDto` picks it up and MapStruct maps it automatically (name matches the entity getter).

The threshold is 80 (warning at 81+ existing today), sitting below the existing daily limit of 100, so the warning and rejection ranges are consistent.
